Metadata.Data Owner: Department of Business Affairs & Consumer Protection

columns.name: Trip ID
columns.description: A unique ID for each trip.

columns.name: Start Time
columns.description: When the trip started, rounded to the nearest hour.

columns.name: End Time
columns.description: When the trip ended, rounded to the nearest hour.

columns.name: Trip Distance
columns.description: Trip distance in meters. (Divide by 1609 for miles.)

columns.name: Accuracy
columns.description: The approximate level of accuracy, in meters, of the GPS measurements reported by the provider.

columns.name: Start Census Tract
columns.description: The Census Tract where the trip started. For privacy, this Census Tract is not shown for some trips.

columns.name: End Census Tract
columns.description: The Census Tract where the trip ended. For privacy, this Census Tract is not shown for some trips.

columns.name: Start Community Area Number
columns.description: The Community Area number where the trip started.

columns.name: End Community Area Number
columns.description: The Community Area number where the trip ended.

columns.name: Start Community Area Name
columns.description: The Community Area name where the trip started.

columns.name: End Community Area Name
columns.description: The Community Area name where the trip ended.

columns.name: Start Centroid Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the center of the trip start census tract or the community area if the census tract has been hidden for privacy. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Start Centroid Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the center of the trip start census tract or the community area if the census tract has been hidden for privacy. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Start Centroid Location
columns.description: The location of the center of the trip start census tract or the community area if the census tract has been hidden for privacy. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the center of the trip end census tract or the community area if the census tract has been hidden for privacy. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the center of the trip end census tract or the community area if the census tract has been hidden for privacy. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Location
columns.description: The location of the center of the trip end census tract or the community area if the census tract has been hidden for privacy. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.
